turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How often should I really change the oil? My dad says every three thousand miles.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That used to be the rule, but most modern cars go much longer, often around five to ten thousand miles. Your manual will give the exact interval.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Huh. So I've been wasting money.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Possibly a little. Though if you do lots of short trips or tow things, changing it more often isn't a bad idea.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do mostly drive to the shops and back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Short trips are harder on oil, so stick to the lower end of the range.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it. And can I just

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can, if you have ramps and somewhere to dispose of the old oil. Many people find a garage isn't much more expensive.
